death.attack.lunar_pulse.player.en: %1$s was consumed by the Heart of Luna while fighting %2$s

death.attack.stellaris.oxygen_deprivatio.en: %1$s ran out of oxygen while fighting %2$s
death.attack.stellaris.oxygen_deprivatio.zh: %1$s 在与 %2$s 战斗时耗尽了氧气

death.attack.stellaris.corrosion.player.zh: %1$s 在与 %2$s 战斗时被腐蚀殆尽了

death.attack.stellaris.infection.player.en: %1$s succumbed to the infection while fighting %2$s
death.attack.stellaris.infection.player.zh: %1$s 在与 %2$s 战斗时死于感染

config.jade.plugin_stellaris.proxy_as_ma.zh: 将多方块结构代理方块作为主方块

item.stellaris.star_crawler_boss_spawn_e.zh: 星界爬行者首领刷怪蛋

block.stellaris.lunar_wall_hanging_sign.zh: 墙上的悬挂式月华木告示牌

gui.stellaris.launchpad_creator.public_c.en: Make this antenna public (allows anyone to use this launch pad)
gui.stellaris.launchpad_creator.public_c.zh: 将此天线设为公开(允许所有人使用此发射台)

tooltip.item.stellaris.pathogen_storage_.en: A sealed containment cell used to store parasites and support research toward an infection cure.
tooltip.item.stellaris.pathogen_storage_.zh: 密封的收容元件, 用于存储寄生虫, 并支持感染治疗研究.

tooltip.item.stellaris.oil_finder.en: Right click on a block to check if there is oil.
tooltip.item.stellaris.oil_finder.zh: 右击方块以检测是否有石油.

tooltip.item.stellaris.tablet.en: Right click to open the wiki.

tooltip.item.stellaris.tablet.lookup.en: Shift + right click a block, or drop an item on the tablet, to jump to its page.
tooltip.item.stellaris.tablet.lookup.zh: Shift+右击方块, 或将物品放到平板电脑上, 可跳转到对应页面.

tooltip.item.stellaris.night_vision_modu.en: Toggle night vision with the Night Vision key.
tooltip.item.stellaris.night_vision_modu.zh: 使用夜视按键切换夜视.

tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.en: This module can be applied to the space suit boots.
tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.zh: 此模块可安装到航天服靴子上.

tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.en: This module can be applied to the space suit leggings.
tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.zh: 此模块可安装到航天服护腿上.

tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.en: This module can be applied to the space suit chestplate.
tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.zh: 此模块可安装到航天服胸甲上.

tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.en: This module can be applied to the space suit helmet.
tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.zh: 此模块可安装到航天服头盔上.

tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.en: This module can be applied to any space suit part.
tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.zh: 此模块可安装到任意航天服部件上.

tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.en: This module can be applied to the rocket.
tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.zh: 此模块可安装到火箭上.

tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.en: This module can be applied to the rover.
tooltip.item.stellaris.can_be_applied_to.zh: 此模块可安装到月球车上.

tooltip.item.stellaris.antenna.en: Right-click a rocket launch pad with this to install it under the pad.
tooltip.item.stellaris.antenna.zh: 手持此物品右击火箭发射台, 可将其安装到发射台下方.

tooltip.item.stellaris.space_station_blu.en: Put it in the rocket inventory to build the station on arrival.
tooltip.item.stellaris.space_station_blu.zh: 放入火箭物品栏, 即可在抵达时建造空间站.

tooltip.item.stellaris.space_station_blu.en: Plan a station in the Engineering Station to use this blueprint.
tooltip.item.stellaris.space_station_blu.zh: 在工程站中规划空间站后才能使用此蓝图.

config.stellaris.enableParasiteDrop.en: Enable Parasite Drops in Blue Liquid
config.stellaris.enableParasiteDrop.zh: 启用蓝色液体中的寄生虫掉落

config.stellaris.oilConfig.pumpjackFluid.en: The fluid the Pumpjack extracts, as a fluid ID. Defaults to stellaris:oil. The Fuel Refinery and the oil slots accept any fluid in the c:oil tag.
config.stellaris.oilConfig.pumpjackFluid.zh: 抽油机抽取的流体, 以流体 ID 表示.默认为 stellaris:oil.燃料精炼厂与油槽接受 c:oil 标签中的任意流体.

config.stellaris.gravityConfig.desc.en: Settings related to planetary gravity simulation.
config.stellaris.gravityConfig.desc.zh: 与行星重力模拟有关的设置.

config.stellaris.gravityConfig.enableGra.en: Enable or disable gravity effects on players.
config.stellaris.gravityConfig.enableGra.zh: 启用或禁用玩家的重力效果.

config.stellaris.gravityConfig.gravityUp.en: How often (in ticks) gravity is recalculated.
config.stellaris.gravityConfig.gravityUp.zh: 重新计算重力的间隔(单位: 刻).

config.stellaris.gravityConfig.minGravit.en: The minimum gravity value the Gravity Manipulator block can set. Values below 0.5 trigger vanilla Minecraft movement bugs.
config.stellaris.gravityConfig.minGravit.zh: 重力操纵器方块可设置的最小重力值. 低于 0.5 会触发原版 Minecraft 的移动错误.

config.stellaris.gravityConfig.maxGravit.en: The maximum gravity value the Gravity Manipulator block can set.
config.stellaris.gravityConfig.maxGravit.zh: 重力操纵器方块可设置的最大重力值.

config.stellaris.gravityConfig.gravityMa.en: Energy consumed per tick while the Gravity Manipulator is active.
config.stellaris.gravityConfig.gravityMa.zh: 重力操纵器工作时每刻消耗的能量.

config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.desc.en: Settings related to the oxygen system.
config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.desc.zh: 与氧气系统有关的设置.

config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.enableOxyg.en: Enable or disable the oxygen system.

config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.oxygenUpda.en: How often (in ticks) oxygen levels are recalculated.
config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.oxygenUpda.zh: 重新计算氧气量的间隔(单位: 刻).

config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.oxygenDama.en: How often (in ticks) damage is applied when oxygen is depleted.
config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.oxygenDama.zh: 氧气耗尽时造成伤害的间隔(单位: 刻).

config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.noOxygenDa.en: Amount of damage dealt per interval when the player has no oxygen.
config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.noOxygenDa.zh: 玩家缺氧时每个间隔受到的伤害量.

config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.baseOxygen.en: Oxygen (in mB) drained from the space suit per interval while standing or walking in vacuum.
config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.baseOxygen.zh: 在真空中站立或行走时, 每个间隔从航天服中消耗的氧气量(单位: mB).

config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.sprintOxyg.en: Multiplies the base oxygen drain while sprinting.
config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.sprintOxyg.zh: 疾跑时基础耗氧量的倍率.

config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.jetOxygenD.en: Multiplies the base oxygen drain while the jetpack is firing.
config.stellaris.oxygenConfig.jetOxygenD.zh: 喷气背包喷射时基础耗氧量的倍率.

config.stellaris.parasiteConfig.desc.en: Settings related to the parasite infection system.
config.stellaris.parasiteConfig.desc.zh: 与寄生虫感染系统有关的设置.

config.stellaris.alienConfig.enableAlien.en: Enable or disable Aliens. When disabled, existing Aliens despawn.
config.stellaris.alienConfig.enableAlien.zh: 启用或禁用外星人. 禁用后已有的外星人会消失.

config.stellaris.orbitTeleportationYCoor.zh: 轨道传送 Y 坐标

config.stellaris.vehicleConfig.desc.en: Settings related to vehicles (rockets, rovers, landers).
config.stellaris.vehicleConfig.desc.zh: 与载具(火箭, 月球车, 着陆舱)有关的设置.

config.stellaris.effectsConfig.desc.en: Settings related to harmful status effects (infection, corrosion).
config.stellaris.effectsConfig.desc.zh: 与有害状态效果(感染, 腐蚀)有关的设置.

config.stellaris.effectsConfig.infection.en: Chance per tick that the Infection effect deals damage, expressed as 1 in N (set to 0 to disable).
config.stellaris.effectsConfig.infection.zh: 感染效果每刻造成伤害的概率, 表示为 1/N(设为 0 则禁用).

config.stellaris.effectsConfig.infection.en: Base damage dealt by the Infection effect (amplifier adds half a point per level).
config.stellaris.effectsConfig.infection.zh: 感染效果造成的基础伤害(每级效果额外增加半点).

config.stellaris.effectsConfig.corrosion.en: How often (in ticks) the Corrosion effect deals damage (set to 0 to disable).
config.stellaris.effectsConfig.corrosion.zh: 腐蚀效果造成伤害的间隔(单位: 刻, 设为 0 则禁用).

config.stellaris.effectsConfig.corrosion.en: Base damage dealt by the Corrosion effect (amplifier adds half a point per level).
config.stellaris.effectsConfig.corrosion.zh: 腐蚀效果造成的基础伤害(每级效果额外增加半点).

config.stellaris.assistantConfig.desc.en: Settings related to the on-board assistant that comments on your exploration.
config.stellaris.assistantConfig.desc.zh: 与随探索进度发表评论的机载助手有关的设置.

config.stellaris.assistantConfig.enableA.en: Enable or disable the assistant messages sent in chat.
config.stellaris.assistantConfig.enableA.zh: 启用或禁用助手发送到聊天栏的消息.

config.stellaris.energyConfig.desc.en: Settings related to how much energy Stellaris produces, stores and consumes.
config.stellaris.energyConfig.desc.zh: 与 Stellaris 能量产出, 存储和消耗相关的设置.

config.stellaris.energyConfig.energyMult.en: Multiplies every Stellaris energy value: generator output, machine and item costs, storage capacities and cable throughput. Ratios between them stay the same. Changes apply to machines when they are next loaded.
config.stellaris.energyConfig.energyMult.zh: 对所有 Stellaris 能量数值进行乘算: 发电机产出, 机器与物品消耗, 存储容量和线缆吞吐.各数值之间的比例保持不变.更改会在机器下次加载时生效.

config.stellaris.vacuumatorEnergyPerCraf.zh: 真空封装机每次加工能耗

config.stellaris.vacuumatorWaterPerCraft.zh: 真空封装机每次加工产水量

config.stellaris.machineConfig.desc.en: Settings related to machine processing and energy use.
config.stellaris.machineConfig.desc.zh: 与机器加工和能耗有关的设置.

config.stellaris.machineConfig.vacuumato.en: Energy consumed by the Vacuumator each time it fills a can, taken up front when the craft starts.
config.stellaris.machineConfig.vacuumato.zh: 真空封装机每次装填罐头消耗的能量, 在加工开始时预先扣除.

config.stellaris.machineConfig.vacuumato.en: Multiplier applied to a food's nutrition to determine vacuumation duration (in ticks).
config.stellaris.machineConfig.vacuumato.zh: 乘以食物营养值后, 得到真空封装耗时(单位: 刻).

config.stellaris.machineConfig.vacuumato.en: Amount of water (in mB) condensed into the Vacuumator's tank each time a can is filled.
config.stellaris.machineConfig.vacuumato.zh: 每次装填罐头时, 冷凝到真空封装机储罐中的水量(单位: mB).

config.stellaris.machineConfig.blenderEn.en: Energy consumed by the Blender each craft, taken up front. Blending recipes may override it with their own "energy" field.
config.stellaris.machineConfig.blenderEn.zh: 搅拌器每次加工消耗的能量, 在开始时预先扣除. 搅拌配方可用自身的 "energy" 字段覆盖该值.

config.stellaris.machineConfig.blenderTi.en: How long the Blender takes per craft, in ticks. Blending recipes may override it with their own "duration" field.
config.stellaris.machineConfig.blenderTi.zh: 搅拌器每次加工所需的刻数. 搅拌配方可用自身的 "duration" 字段覆盖该值.

config.stellaris.showOxygenDebug.desc.en: Show oxygen debug information on the HUD.
config.stellaris.showOxygenDebug.desc.zh: 在 HUD 上显示氧气调试信息.

config.stellaris.fluidOutputConfig.desc.en: Settings for the fluid output visualisation.
config.stellaris.fluidOutputConfig.desc.zh: 流体输出可视化的设置.

config.stellaris.fluidOutputConfig.showN.en: Highlight neighbour blocks when configuring fluid output.
config.stellaris.fluidOutputConfig.showN.zh: 配置流体输出时高亮相邻方块.

config.stellaris.fluidOutputConfig.fluid.en: Colors used to identify each fluid output side.
config.stellaris.fluidOutputConfig.fluid.zh: 用于标识各个流体输出面的颜色.

config.stellaris_client.landerThirdPerso.zh: 着陆舱自动第三人称视角

config.stellaris_client.emissiveTextures.zh: 显示实体的自发光纹理.

config.stellaris.landerThirdPerson.desc.en: Switch to third person automatically while riding a lander.
config.stellaris.landerThirdPerson.desc.zh: 乘坐着陆舱时自动切换为第三人称视角.

tooltip.item.stellaris.diesel_tank_modul.en: Store up to %smb of diesel on your space suit.
tooltip.item.stellaris.diesel_tank_modul.zh: 在航天服上最多存储 %smb 柴油.

tooltip.item.stellaris.hydrogen_tank_mod.en: Store up to %smb of hydrogen on your space suit.
tooltip.item.stellaris.hydrogen_tank_mod.zh: 在航天服上最多存储 %smb 氢气.

tooltip.item.stellaris.oxygen_module.cap.en: Store up to %smb of oxygen on your space suit.
tooltip.item.stellaris.oxygen_module.cap.zh: 在航天服上最多存储 %smb 氧气.

tooltip.item.stellaris.jet_module.consum.en: Consumes %smb of fuel per second to allow you to fly.
tooltip.item.stellaris.jet_module.consum.zh: 每秒消耗 %smb 燃料以供飞行.

tooltip.item.stellaris.jet_module.climb.en: Climbs at up to %s blocks per tick.

tooltip.item.stellaris.oil_finder_module.en: Find oil in a %s x %s chunks area.
tooltip.item.stellaris.oil_finder_module.zh: 在 %s x %s 区块范围内探测石油.

tooltip.item.stellaris.space_suit.oil_fi.en: Allows detection of oil deposits in the surrounding %s x %s area
tooltip.item.stellaris.space_suit.oil_fi.zh: 可探测周围 %s x %s 范围内的油藏

tooltip.item.stellaris.space_suit.jet_mo.zh: 飞行上升速度: %s 格/刻
